messages:
Carmen Diaz: Postmortem follow-up: two regressions slipped past staged rollouts. We sketched fixes — putting final owners, deliverables, and short timelines here so nothing falls through.
Owen Park: I'll own the auto-rollback workflow. Plan: small rules evaluator that looks at error rate, p95, and user-visible errors; it will call an idempotent `POST /rollouts/{id}/action` with `pause|throttle|rollback`. Prototype by end of week.
Lina Torres: I'll take flag metadata and blast-radius enforcement. Proposal: require `max_blast_radius` at flag creation, add a pre-merge lint, and a CI gate. I'll draft schema + CLI lint; PR by Thursday.
Victor Nguyen: I'll do telemetry and recurring-pattern detection. Tasks: backfill 30 days for baselines, add `canary_spike` and `p95_shift` saved queries, and wire alerts to #eng-oncall + owner. Jobs live by next Monday.
Carmen Diaz: Please paste PRs here as you open them. Also scheduling a recurring 30m sync weekly for 6 weeks to track progress.
Owen Park: Implementation detail: soft-throttle action should reduce rollout to 0.1% and collect 15m extra signal before escalating. All actions must emit structured audit events and include the triggering rule.
Lina Torres: Suggested rollout snippet to include in docs:

```yaml
rollout_policy:
  stages: [0.005, 0.02, 0.1, 1.0]
  max_blast_radius: 0.02
  monitor:
    error_rate: { threshold_pct: 1.0, window_s: 120, action: rollback }
    p95_latency: { threshold_ms: 600, window_s: 300, action: pause }
```

Victor Nguyen: Saved queries I'll add: `canary_spike` (alert on 4x baseline within 10m) and `p95_shift` (+30% sustained 15m). Will post dashboard links to #eng-observability when ready.
Carmen Diaz: Ownership matrix for postmortem doc: Owen -> auto-rollback (proto EOW), Lina -> flags/schema + lint (PR Thu), Victor -> telemetry + dashboards (jobs Mon), Carmen -> runbook + follow-ups. Rotate primary monthly and add backups.
DevOps-bot: Event scheduled: "Rollout safety follow-ups" weekly Tue 10:00 for 6 occurrences.
Owen Park: Draft PR for rollback prototype: https://git.redwood/ri/guardrails/pulls/770 (WIP).
Lina Torres: Draft PR for flag schema + lint: https://git.redwood/ri/flags/pulls/314 (WIP).
Victor Nguyen: Backfill started; will ping when dashboards + alerts are wired.
Carmen Diaz: Final note: treat recurring patterns as owned workstreams. Primary owners should triage weekly and escalate if patterns reappear. React with :white_check_mark: once your first PR is filed so I can mark action items in the postmortem.
